comments.text: Confirmed compile-time regression in Zaq.Ingestion.Api on Elixir 1.20.4. Isolated Code.compile_file with HEAD source: 1.04s/89 MiB RSS; current: >2118 MiB, stopped. All handle_event bodies replaced with :ok still exceeds 1556 MiB. Dependency-free event struct + clause heads reproduces >1562 MiB; action-first heads compile in 0.85s/90 MiB. Full temporary module with unchanged public handle_event(event,action,context) delegating to private dispatch_event(action,event,context) compiles in 1.39s/261 MiB. Confirms type inference complexity from overlapping first-argument event/request patterns; exact upstream algorithmic defect not established. Runtime traces identify Module.Types.Descr BDD operations. Source unchanged; compilation-only workaround validated, runtime equivalence not tested. Probes and results: /tmp/zaq-api-memory-xktjqbc2.
